Landed at 22855ef. Three hsmm/v2 -> hsmm/v3 renames, VERIFIED rather than assumed: codec/align.scala:59 is "hsmm/v3", the only remaining golden resource is hsmm-v3-wog.json, and line 38 of the same file already said v3. Gate in a clone: fixturesJVM Passed: Total 117, Failed 0, Errors 0, TEST_EXIT=0; scalafmtCheckAll FMT_EXIT=0.

Note for the record: the harness reported the backgrounded gate as 'exit code 0' while sbt was still compiling the story module. That is the fork's status, not the run's -- exactly what AGENTS.md rule 4 warns about. The totals above come from waiting on the in-script TEST_EXIT marker. Had I trusted the harness report I would have committed on a gate that had not run a single test.
